municipalities.title: Municipalities
municipalities.description: Greek municipality names to search (e.g. Αθηναίων, Θεσσαλονίκης). Leave empty for defaults.

max_antennas.title: Max antennas (0 = unlimited)
max_antennas.description: Cap on total antennas processed in stage 2 (cost control). 0 means no cap. Kept small by default so Apify Store daily tests finish within 5 minutes; raise it for full cycles.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
